devops.title: DevOps Engineer
devops.tagline: Your path from zero → job ready.

tracks.title: Linux
tracks.what: The operating system layer everything else runs on.
tracks.why: Shell comfort, file permissions, and process management are assumed in every task ahead.

tracks.title: Git
tracks.what: Version control for infrastructure and application code alike.
tracks.why: Every DevOps workflow assumes fluent Git — branching, merging, and history.

tracks.title: Networking
tracks.what: How machines actually talk to each other.
tracks.why: Makes "why is this unreachable" answerable instead of a guessing game.

chain.title: Docker
chain.what: Package an application and its dependencies into a portable container.
chain.why: The unit almost everything downstream (Cloud, CI/CD, Kubernetes) is built around.
chain.build: Containerize a small web application end to end.

chain.title: Cloud
chain.what: AWS, Azure, or GCP — infrastructure you rent instead of own.
chain.why: Pick one and go deep before spreading across all three. The concepts transfer; the exact APIs don't.

chain.title: CI / CD
chain.why: Shipping becomes a routine event, not a stressful manual ritual.

chain.title: Terraform
chain.what: Define infrastructure as code instead of clicking through a cloud console.
chain.why: Reproducible, reviewable, versioned infrastructure — not tribal knowledge.

chain.title: Kubernetes
chain.why: For when a single Docker host isn't enough anymore.

chain.title: Projects
chain.what: Build something real, end to end.
chain.why: This is what actually gets noticed on a CV — not another tutorial completion.
chain.build: A CI/CD pipeline for a real app, or a Terraform-provisioned cluster.

embedded.title: Embedded Engineer
embedded.tagline: Build software that runs close to hardware.

ai-ml.title: AI / ML Engineer
ai-ml.tagline: Build intelligent systems with data and AI.
